subject: Observability & Ops tooling: competitive comparison, next tests
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Tim Lee <tim.lee@acme.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-10T18:05:00Z
Subject: Post-call recap: Observability & ops tooling (Redwood vs hyperscalers)

Hi Tim — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment: 

- Key goals you shared: (1) predictable per-token economics, (2) end-to-end latency SLOs for interactive agents, (3) unified observability across host/hybrid/private deployments.
- Main competitive concerns: how Redwood's telemetry/dashboards compare to AWS/Google managed endpoints (we heard Bedrock + Cloud Run patterns) and what the test matrix looks like for tracing KV cache warmups and request-level cost breakdowns.

Proposed next steps:
1) Send a short eval plan with the comparison matrix (attached) — covers latency, cost, trace fidelity, token-level cost breakdowns.
2) Schedule a 90-min working session next week to run the targeted tests (warm vs cold KV cache, 1k vs 10k concurrent tokens, streaming behavior).
3) Loop in an SE to help run the tests and share dashboards.

I've attached a one-page eval plan and a telemetry matrix for quick review. If this looks good, can we lock in Wed 6/16 10am PT for the working session?

Looking forward —
Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
[Attachment: ACME-eval-plan.pdf (2 pages)]

From: Tim Lee <tim.lee@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme.com>
Date: 2026-06-10T20:12:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Observability & ops tooling (Redwood vs hyperscalers)

Thanks Marissa — this is helpful. A couple clarifying Qs before we lock the session: 

1) Hyperscaler parity: When we run the matrix, are we testing Redwood-hosted models vs Bedrock-hosted models (same model family) or Redwood runtime running customer-owned model on-prem vs AWS serving? We need the apples-to-apples comparison because procurement will ask about "pricing per token" vs our current Bedrock bill.
2) Traces & attribution: Can your dashboards break down cost per request by model variant + storage of KV cache? We want to understand if a heavy prefix (prompt engineering) drives disproportionate cost.
3) Compliance: We'll want an example of audit logs and how long traces/usage are retained.

If you can address these in the session, Wed 6/16 10am PT works.

Tim
Senior ML Eng, Acme Corp
tim.lee@acme.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Tim Lee <tim.lee@acme.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-11T01:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Observability & ops tooling (Redwood vs hyperscalers)

Great questions — answers at a high level so we can be specific in the session: 

1) Comparison plan: We'll run two legs: (A) Redwood hosted API (our managed infra) vs Bedrock managed endpoints (same open model family where available) for throughput & cost; (B) Redwood Private (customer-managed VPC) running the same model binary you currently evaluate — this shows delta on network egress and infra ops. Both legs are in the eval plan and we'll mark which metrics are apples-to-apples.

2) Traces & attribution: Yes — our Console provides per-request trace that links request->model-variant->KV-cache-hits, and a token-level cost breakdown. We'll show a dashboard that surfaces (a) cost per request, (b) cost per token buckets by prefix length, and (c) cumulative KV-cache hit rates over time.

3) Compliance/retention: Default telemetry retention is 90 days for hosted; Private customers can configure retention and push to your KMS-backed S3. We'll bring example audit logs and the SOC2 evidence artifact.

Looping in Aditya (SE) to run the test matrix and Stephanie for any contractual/terms questions. SEs: can you confirm the test harness and resources needed on Acme side?

Thanks —
Marissa

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Tim Lee <tim.lee@acme.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-11T05:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Observability & ops tooling (Redwood vs hyperscalers)

Hi Tim — thanks, excited to run this. Quick logistics and request list for an efficient session: 

- We plan 90 minutes: 15m setup, 60m tests, 15m debrief. Please confirm whether you have a sandbox Bedrock account we can use or if we should provision equivalent hosted runs from our Redwood eval cluster. 
- Minimal artifacts we need from Acme: a) representative prompt set (5-10 typical requests), b) a short sample dataset for embeddings if you want to test embed pipeline, and c) any IP/network constraints for Private run.
- We'll provide: a prepared Grafana dashboard + Console view (cost/token breakdown), a trace export for one sample request, and an eval script to reproduce tests.

Attached: evaluation plan + a telemetry matrix I use as checklist. I'll also attach a short runbook for the session.

If Wed 6/16 10am PT is good, I can reserve the slot and share a calendar invite with runbook.

-Aditya
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com
[Attachment: redwood-vs-hyperscaler-telemetry-matrix.xlsx]

From: Tim Lee <tim.lee@acme.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme.com>
Date: 2026-06-11T12:10:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Observability & ops tooling (Redwood vs hyperscalers)

Thanks Aditya — Wed 6/16 10am PT confirmed. We don't have a Bedrock sandbox available right now; for apples-to-apples please run Redwood-hosted vs Bedrock-managed using the same open model family (we can provide the Bedrock billing snapshots afterwards). I'll upload the prompt set and a short dataset to the Drive link you shared by EOD Monday. Priya will own the dataset upload.

Also one ask: can you include a side-by-side view comparing (a) Redwood token-level cost breakdown, (b) Bedrock estimated per-token cost, and (c) a hypothetical private deployment cost delta (network + infra) — we want to show procurement a single slide with the numbers.

-Tim

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
To: Tim Lee <tim.lee@acme.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-12T16:40:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Observability & ops tooling (Redwood vs hyperscalers)

Thanks all — I'll prep a one-slide commercial summary (token cost, reserved vs hosted, and retention/SLAs) and share it before the session. Marissa — I may reach out about a short commercial note (discount band for Dedicated trial) depending on scale.

See you on 6/16.

Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: commercial-summary-draft.pdf (1 page)]
